description: This PHP source file defines the 'Pickup' class within the OpenCart admin extension for shipping methods. It manages the rendering of the Pickup shipping method configuration page and the saving of its settings.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Pickup shipping method configuration in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Pickup shipping method, including breadcrumbs, settings, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Pickup shipping method settings, including permission check and JSON response.
